eyebrow: TELVERGENCE × YES — Your Electrical Solutions · Miami-Dade · South Florida
h1b: We make it ring to you.
tagline: When the power goes out, nobody shops — they call the first electrician who answers. We turn YES into a 10-line Smart-DID grid across Miami-Dade where every outage, panel, generator, and EV-charger call is answered instantly, in the caller's language, and routed to the nearest available truck.
demoNote: Miami electrical campaign · outage · panel · generator · EV charger · 10-line pack · numbers pending assignment
insight: an electrical job runs $400–$15,000+ — panel upgrades, generators, and EV chargers sit at the top of that range, and the calls spike the moment the power drops or a storm is forecast. Demand arrives all at once, at night, and the electrician on a ladder cannot answer it. A phone number that just rings can't. A Smart DID can.
benchNow: One number, untracked — no idea which ad produced the call
Crew is on a job, so the outage call goes to voicemail
No Spanish line in a Spanish-speaking market
Emergency and scheduled work share one queue
No after-hours answer — when outages actually happen
Inbound only — no outbound to storm-hit or commercial accounts
benchNext: 10 Smart DIDs, every call source-tagged, recorded, mapped
24/7 AI answer — the outage call is never voicemail
Outbound dialer works storm-hit ZIPs and commercial accounts

dids.p: Priority ring, never voicemail — the outage line that owns your #1 promise: someone comes tonight.
Routes Spanish callers to a bilingual path — a South Florida edge nobody else runs.
The high-ticket residential job, separated and prioritized.
Surges on every storm forecast — capacity scales with the weather.
The fastest-growing residential add-on, tracked on its own.
Contract work routed to the commercial desk, not the retail queue.
Post-storm surge line — the calls that come in waves.
Proves ad ROI to the dollar — swap the number, keep the data.
Attributes offline campaigns so you stop guessing.
The dialer's outbound face — it presents your flagship number as caller ID so every callback lands on the line you already track.

pillars.p: A compliant dialer works storm-hit ZIPs and commercial accounts — branded caller-ID, compliant scripting, recordings, callbacks.
10 tracked lines + 24/7 AI answer + SMS. Every source measured, emergencies prioritized, every missed call auto-called-back.
Calls, texts, booked jobs, ad spend and source — one live dashboard. You finally see which dollar produced which job.
